messages:
kai: Rollout finished for canary cohort (v1.12.0) in eu-west1. Deploybot shows 6/6 hosts in service. Starting a 10m post-deploy smoke window now.

deploy-bot: canary:eu-west1 -> 10% traffic, hosts=6, status=UP. synth-check id=svc-smoke-8842 started.

maria: quick heads-up — after ~3m into the window I'm seeing p95 embed latency jump in the synth from ~120ms -> ~270ms for eu-west1. Not all probes fail but the distribution is skewed.

kai: can you paste a sample probe / output? any 5xxs?

maria: sample curl from synth agent:
```
POST /v1/embed
{"input":"hello world"}
-> 200 OK  latency=268ms  token_cost=0.004
```
also instrument logs show a small cluster of 503s (~1.2% of requests) during the spike window.

ash: (oncall) looking at traces — majority of slow traces have KV cache misses at prefix lookup, spike in cold starts from new hosts. Not a full outage but increases tail. Kernel selection for qint8 looks different on these hosts compared to staging.

sam: agree we should be conservative. Suggest pause further rollout (hold at 10%) and pin routing for eu-west1 back to v1.11.9 for any new sessions until triage completes. Also try a prefill / warmup tweak on the canaries.

kai: good call. @deploy-bot please pause and pin fallback variant for eu-west1.

deploy-bot: actioned: canary rollout paused at 10% by kai. fallback_pin=release/v1.11.9 applied for region=eu-west1. synth-check continues in read-only.

maria: I'll open INF-3421 with the attach logs and sample traces. Re-running small synth with prefill enabled now. Will report after 12m warmup.

lia: FYI — no similar signal in us-west1 or apac. Region-only suggests infra/kernel/driver differences. Will grab per-host kernel selection logs and GPU driver versions.

ash: I'll coordinate with eng-infra on driver version matrix. If p95 doesn't move after prefill+warmup, we'll escalate to rollback.

maria: after 12m warmup + prefill: p95 steady ~140ms on the re-run synth (back near baseline), 503s gone. Looks like coldstart warmup fixed the tail for these hosts.

sam: that's promising. Recommendation: keep canary paused for a full 15m verification window, then unpause to 25% with the warmup prefill enabled and expanded telemetry for kv-miss rates.

kai: ok — plan: keep pinned fallback for new sessions, hold at 10% for 15m, if metrics stable then resume to 25% with prefill. I'll update release notes and close INF-3421 once we confirm. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll monitor p95 and kv-miss rate and post a final update in 10m.

deploy-bot: note: rollout state saved -> paused. audit:kai@1735674321.

kai: thanks everyone — keep this thread for the 15m verification; if anything degrades we'll rollback.

maria: 10m update: p95 holds ~138ms, kv-misses <0.1%. leaning +1 to unpause per plan after 5 more mins.

lia: collecting host kernel logs now and will post matrix to INF-3421.

ash: if we unpause, let's enable the canary-specific prefill TTL to 60s for the next hour to reduce coldstarts.

kai: agreed. Reopen if we see any reversion.
